parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the topmost part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, typically small and ergonomically shaped for finger pressing.
parts.Functional_description: It is used to press down and activate the pump mechanism, dispensing liquid soap or sanitizer.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically when pressed, returning to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head section connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and outlet nozzle, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the outlet when the lid is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers motion from the lid to the internal pump.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier part is the nozzle or spout through which the liquid exits, made of plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the flow of liquid soap outward in a controlled stream.
parts.Movement_description: It does not move independently but allows liquid to pass through when the pump is activated.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent PET plastic, typically rectangular or cylindrical.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid soap or sanitizer and supports the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary during use, serving as the structural and storage component.
